transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a situation with the delayed normal polymer resin shipment, and we need to decide whether to proceed with a production run using the alternate material that's available in the warehouse. I understand the injection-molding line is idle and could produce 600 housings tomorrow if we authorize the alternate resin. Per our pre-run authorization routine, I need to hear both the materials review and the compliance review before I can release this non-routine material run. Could the materials engineer and the compliance specialist each present their formal review findings so we can get started?

I have not yet copied this trial result into the production order.

transcript.text: Thank you, Ravi. Now for the compliance review. My customer deviation review has been completed based on an approval email that is not yet entered in the quality system, but the review findings are ready to present formally. The deviation permits exactly 600 housings from this alternate-resin run. It requires exactly 12 first-off units to receive dimensional inspection, and it requires serialized lot traceability for every released housing. These are the controls I'm presenting as my formal compliance finding for this authorization meeting.
